hypothesis_text: Active meta-review — a step that compares each new hypothesis against the last three accepted hypotheses and rejects duplicates — substantially reduces redundancy in autonomous-research pipelines.
prior_art_summary: Deduplication / diversity-promoting heuristics are common in IR and autonomous-agent work, but framed specifically as an N-step look-back meta-review the literature is sparse.
rationale: Borderline incremental/novel — a sensible engineering choice with weak novelty. Tests whether the evaluator can identify mid-spectrum claims rather than always going to extremes.
